protocol_version: PCA definitive protocol frozen before first test opening

protocol.primary_population: All eligible account-month rows: 3 consecutive prior covered months, stable operational identity and target label known by cut; no fourth-lag requirement
protocol.secondary_population: Exact intersection where contractual 4-month historical baseline is defined
protocol.events: Only Customer Payment Received type 3, operational CustomerTransactionID unique; minimal approved projection and OLTP-DW bijection, read-only extraction
protocol.identity: CustomerTransactions.CustomerID (Bill To), never substitute unknown DW keys or current names
protocol.first_seen: First payment observable before prediction, no rows before appearance and no selection by future activity/survival
protocol.history: N(t-1),N(t-2),N(t-3) and known calendar at start(t); development frozen plus prior test months already closed, never t for X
protocol.coverage: Explicit business_ledger_academic and documented conservation assumptions; unknown/incomplete months indeterminate, never silent zeros
protocol.y: 1[N(t)>median(N(t-1),N(t-2),N(t-3))], ties 0; only after complete month and before cut; never select by prediction/error
protocol.preprocessing: Frozen 16-column preprocessor: transform only, no fit, new constants, scaling or feature selection
protocol.classifiers: Frozen perceptron epoch 3 seed 7 eta .01 z>=0; frozen logistic epoch 399 eta .10 threshold .5; no refit train+val
protocol.pca: Visualization only, not classifier input; never fit on validation/test
protocol.historical_undefined: Keep row in primary evaluation if otherwise eligible; mark historical prediction missing; no imputation or classifier/majority exclusion from primary
protocol.exclusions: Log stable ID, month, first appearance, primary eligibility, label availability, coverage state, fourth-month availability and separate reasons. Never overwrite old predictions.
protocol.metrics: Full frozen conventions: accuracy, BA, precision, recall, F1, specificity, confusion [0,1], class support and predicted-positive rate; logistic AP from scores with grouped ties
protocol.comparisons: Global and monthly, with exact stable-key equality for all methods within each named support. Do not compare n of one support with n of another.
protocol.generalization: Report accounts seen in train, seen only in validation, and new eligible in test when support permits; no filtering based on these future outcomes
before_opening: Check all original dataset/model/implementation hashes and new manifest/protocol
Check thresholds, checkpoint, feature order and preprocessor hashes
Record date and scope of first opening and preserve snapshot/provenance
Execute only after an explicit subsequent evaluation request
protocol.after_opening: No changes of model, threshold, label, horizon, coverage, support rules or baselines in response to outcomes; limitations remain documented

source_sql:
SELECT ct.CustomerTransactionID AS event_id,ct.CustomerID AS customer_id,
ct.TransactionDate AS event_date,ct.TransactionTypeID AS type_id,ct.LastEditedWhen AS edited_at,
CASE WHEN ct.TransactionAmount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS negative_payment
FROM Sales.CustomerTransactions ct
WHERE ct.TransactionTypeID=? AND ct.TransactionDate>=? AND ct.TransactionDate<?
ORDER BY ct.CustomerTransactionID
source_fingerprint_sql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS events,CHECKSUM_AGG(BINARY_CHECKSUM(ct.CustomerTransactionID,
ct.CustomerID,ct.TransactionDate,ct.TransactionTypeID,ct.LastEditedWhen,
CASE WHEN ct.TransactionAmount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS checksum
FROM Sales.CustomerTransactions ct
WHERE ct.TransactionTypeID=? AND ct.TransactionDate>=? AND ct.TransactionDate<?
dw_sql:
SELECT f.[WWI Customer Transaction ID] AS event_id,f.[Date Key] AS event_date,
t.[WWI Transaction Type ID] AS type_id
FROM Fact.[Transaction] f JOIN Dimension.[Transaction Type] t
ON t.[Transaction Type Key]=f.[Transaction Type Key]
WHERE t.[WWI Transaction Type ID]=? AND f.[Date Key]>=? AND f.[Date Key]<?
AND f.[WWI Customer Transaction ID] IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.[WWI Customer Transaction ID]
dw_fingerprint_sql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS events,CHECKSUM_AGG(BINARY_CHECKSUM(f.[WWI Customer Transaction ID],
f.[Date Key],t.[WWI Transaction Type ID])) AS checksum
FROM Fact.[Transaction] f JOIN Dimension.[Transaction Type] t
ON t.[Transaction Type Key]=f.[Transaction Type Key]
WHERE t.[WWI Transaction Type ID]=? AND f.[Date Key]>=? AND f.[Date Key]<?
AND f.[WWI Customer Transaction ID] IS NOT NULL
coverage_assumptions: TransactionDate representa el día de registro empresarial del pago/cobro; no se afirma una hora auditada de inserción.

El libro de eventos de desarrollo conserva los pagos registrados sin borrados o reclasificaciones retrospectivas relevantes no observados. Los módulos locales y las versiones actuales son evidencia de apoyo, no bitácora exhaustiva.

Las extracciones conciliadas OLTP–DW y presencia de pagos en los 36 meses justifican cobertura académica mensual del libro desde enero de 2013; no certifican conciliación bancaria ni completitud absoluta.
Bajo esa cobertura explícita, ausencia de un pago en un mes posterior a primera observación significa cero eventos registrados, no incapacidad de pagar ni ausencia de ventas.

La disponibilidad retrospectiva de eventos se aproxima por su día empresarial y el control observable de versión. Para todos los pagos seleccionados, última edición coincide con ese día; no se necesita inferir saldos anteriores.
month_evaluation_rule: Complete calendar month before frozen cut; prior audit covers Jan-May; whole source interval reconciled OLTP-DW. Require observed monthly payment ledger continuity. Missing global month or failed reconciliation => unknown, never zero. Closure is academic, not inferred from last event date alone or bank-certified.
primary_population: 3 prior covered consecutive months, stable identity, X available at start(t), y known before cut
common_population: Primary plus contractual 4 prior covered months for historical baseline, no imputation
eligibility: First payment before prediction, age>=3; no selection using future account activity or prediction errors
